original_title: Talk on 3D Environments as a Planning Tool
original_content_full:
Talk on 3D Environments as a Planning Tool

Juri Engel will contribute to the workshop “3D Geodata for Planing Purposes”, which is organized by GEOkomm and OpTecBB and is held on Dec 1, 2011, at GFZ Potsdam. Juri will present his work in the context of “Immersive 3D Environments for Decision Support in City Planning”.
